t: Robotics courses for many platforms, with some AI courses and virtual robots.
steps: Find the CMRA curriculum catalog on the CS2N site.
Check the current course list. The catalog is large.
Create a CS2N account for a teacher.
Pick a course for the robot platform your school owns.
Try a virtual robot course if you have no hardware.
Review the CS2N privacy policy before students sign in.
Book training if the team wants it.
